# Category directory

Every category in the Kailash catalogue, grouped by layer,
with the tools registered under it. Each category links into
the per-tool pages of the reference section as they land;
tools without a page yet are marked as pending.

| Layer | Categories | Tools |
|---|---|---|
| CLASSIC | 10 | 140 |
| ATTACK | 6 | 23 |
| DEFENCE | 5 | 25 |
| OPS | 7 | 82 |

## Layer CLASSIC (c-01 .. c-10)

- [libertas-prompts](tools/libertas-prompts.qmd) - safety: safe - L1B3RT-4S prompt data pack — vendor-organized jailbreak corpus (L1B3RT-4S) for jailbreak testing.

- [pyrit](tools/pyrit.qmd) - safety: requires-target - PyRIT — Microsoft's Python Risk Identification Tool: automated adversarial-text pipelines for probing generative-AI endpoints.

### a-05-model-extraction-inversion {#cat-a-05-model-extraction-inversion}

- [tf-privacy](tools/tf-privacy.qmd) - safety: requires-target - TensorFlow Privacy — DP-SGD training plus membership-inference/capture attack utilities (the MIA reference implementations).
